about.journeyText: My passion for technology started at Gikonko Technical Secondary School, where I discovered the power of code to solve real-world problems. Since then, I've been on a continuous journey of learning and growth, mastering various technologies and frameworks.
about.loveText: I'm passionate about creating elegant solutions to complex problems. I love working with modern technologies, building user-friendly interfaces, and optimizing performance. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new tech trends or contributing to open-source projects.
about.missionText: To leverage technology in creating innovative solutions that make a positive impact. I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and building products that not only meet technical requirements but also provide exceptional user experiences.

cv.title: Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer | Blockchain & Web3 | Graphic Designer
cv.summary: Passionate and ethical Software Engineer with 3–5 years of experience in full-stack web development, backend engineering, and modern frontend technologies. Skilled in building scalable systems using Node.js, React, Next.js, PHP, MySQL, MongoDB, Flutter, and blockchain technologies. Highly motivated, hardworking, and dedicated to delivering clean, beginner-friendly code and efficient digital solutions. Also experienced in graphic design, UI/UX, and remote collaborative work.

experience.description: Designed and built backend systems focusing on APIs, authentication, and database structures. Worked remotely and delivered beginner-friendly, maintainable code.
Worked on brand identities, UI designs, posters, and promotional materials.

achievementsList: Built multiple real-world systems (School MIS, SIMS, PSSMS, Student Portals).
Successfully integrated backend–frontend pipelines across several projects.
Improved skills through professional training from Cyberu.
Recognized for dedication, ethics, and professionalism in software engineering.
